verdict.rationale: Docs only mention a default *command* timeout within a session (cloudflare-sandbox-docs-19), not a sandbox-level idle/shutdown timeout tied to billing; a related Containers doc claims auto-shutdown after no requests (cloudflare-sandbox-comm-5), but a developer who reviewed the docs explicitly states 'it does not seem to be possible to auto destroy a sandbox after certain amount of idle time... forces whoever is implementing this to do their own cleanup' (cloudflare-sandbox-comm-7), directly contradicting the claimed capability. missing for 10: documented sandbox-level idle-timeout/auto-shutdown API, evidence tying timeout to billing cessation, and resolution of the community-reported gap.
